drills.q: Pick compute for: legacy .NET Framework site, bursty queue consumer, 40-service estate with platform team.
drills.a: .NET Framework: App Service Windows plans (Flex is Linux-only). Queue consumer: Container Apps with KEDA scaler min 0. 40 services + platform team: AKS Standard with node autoprovisioning.

drills.q: Why does Terraform-recreated VM lose all access despite identical config?
drills.a: System-assigned MI: new VM = new principalId = zero role assignments. Use user-assigned identity decoupled from compute lifecycle, or re-run assignment against new principalId in same apply.

drills.q: Container Apps app thrashes between 0 and 1 replicas on a latency-sensitive endpoint. Options?
drills.a: Set minReplicas=1 (idle billing at reduced rate) to avoid activation latency; note Dapr actors require it anyway; scale-down stabilization ~300 s and cooldown ~300 s shape the flapping otherwise.

drills.q: AKS cluster is two minors behind current GA. What's the upgrade path constraint?
drills.a: Cannot skip more than one minor per hop - sequential N-2 -> N-1 -> N upgrades, control plane then node pools, surge nodes for disruption control; automate cadence quarterly to stay within N-2.

drills.q: Pods Pending, nodes have free CPU. Systematic diagnosis?
drills.a: Check events: FailedCreatePodSandBox = subnet IP exhaustion (plain CNI); then taints/tolerations, topology/zone constraints, PVC zonal mismatch, regional vCPU quota blocking autoscaler. Read autoscaler logs for provisioning failures.

drills.q: Design zone HA for stateless API + PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
drills.a: API instances spread across zones behind zone-redundant LB/Front Door; PG Flexible zone-redundant HA sync standby other zone (~99.99% SLA, failover ~60-120 s); size headroom to survive losing one full zone.

drills.q: Nightly batch on Spot VMs keeps dying mid-run. Make it survivable.
drills.a: Checkpointed idempotent work units, drain on Scheduled Events (~30 s notice), eviction-rate monitoring, spot baseline plus regular-capacity ceiling, orchestrator-level retry-on-evict.

drills.q: Staging-tested change breaks prod instantly after slot swap. Two likely causes?
drills.a: Slot-sticky settings inversion (config didn't swap) or cold-start masquerade (warm-up passed but first real requests hit unexercised paths). Audit sticky settings, real warm-up paths, verify config parity.

drills.q: VMSS autoscale rules correct but instances stop growing at N. Root cause class?
drills.a: Regional vCPU quota exhausted, not a scale-rule problem; check quota before debugging rules and request increases proactively in IaC pipelines.

drills.q: Argue against AKS for a 4-service team, then counter yourself.
drills.a: Against: CA delivers revisions/KEDA/ingress with fraction of ops (upgrades, RBAC, security). Counter: imminent GPU needs, company standards assume cluster tooling. Resolve: start CA with explicit promotion criteria - reversible beats speculative platform investment.
